source_views.translation_trust_boundary: Existing exact full TypedSource.original, with successful checked algorithm admission. Values use concrete fp32 words in its historical real channel, with every product/tree leaf/seed/block-add retained. Actual complete programs are sequentially composed over shared memory, matching independent reference memory recurrence. Host allocation requests and ordered guards are logical metadata with an explicit allocator primitive boundary. Native Python/allocator/compiler/ABI/concurrency refinement remains separate.

declarations.dtype_profile: Full wrapper-declared fp32 A/B/output; concrete fp32 words, configurable scalar mul/add, valid explicit reduction trees, all dynamic K blocks, arbitrary natural model dimensions and block sizes. Complete original per-program source, with no successful-execution or output-equality premise.

original_scope.covered: Complete original fp32 per-program value execution with independent final-memory reference and frame.
remaining_structural_obligations: Host Arguments use natural metadata; arbitrary Python types, negative dimensions/blocks/tuning remain outside the Lean host domain. Source probes confirm some negative blocks pass assertions and reach negative-grid or invalid-block dispatch.

Allocator is an explicit non-numerical callback for all three ordered fp32 CUDA requests. Native allocation failure behavior, fresh physical separation, contiguous fp32 cells and tensor-to-region/byte-memory/ABI representation remain unbound. Kernel correctness quantifies all produced words, requiring no RNG distribution law.
Address bounds and output/K coverage are proved for natural element indices. Fixed-width sizes, intermediate overflow, storage representation and native pointer correspondence remain open.
Native block/arange/resource legality, empty grids and zero-K specialization admission, and supported num_warps/num_stages remain open; Python accepts some non-power-of-two blocks and invalid tuning.
Complete grid is one explicit sequential pid0-fastest schedule. Native allocation freshness, race freedom and concurrent schedule refinement remain unproved.
Source equality uses the existing full admitted TypedSource.original transcription. Static source comparison and wrapper AST probes do not constitute a verified Python compiler translation.
remaining_native_numerical_bindings: Bind chosen FP.Config and concrete fp32 FP.add/FP.mul behavior to device rounding, FTZ, infinities/NaNs, signed zero and special-value handling.
Identify and bind actual native reduction tree and explicit padding/seeds to the supplied valid ReductionPlan at block_k.
Bind compiler fusion/reassociation and any operation contraction across product/reduction/block-accumulation boundaries; no equality to a real sum is assumed.
